---
name: security-review
description: "Review a Gate-OS feature or release for authentication, privilege, sandbox, supply-chain, telemetry, and secret-handling risks."
---

Delegate targeted checks to security and backend agents. Threat-model new boundaries, test negative cases, verify pins/signatures, inspect logs for secrets, and write findings with severity, exploitability, evidence, and remediation. Stop if a critical issue is open.
